critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the window placement array along the fuselage to introduce variable spacing. Specifically, increase the gap size between windows by a ratio of 2.5x in the areas corresponding to door locations (the 'door zones'), while maintaining the current uniform spacing for all other sections of the cabin.

discrepancies.observed: A single large dark block at the nose
discrepancies.reference: A multi-paneled array of distinct windows

discrepancies.observed: A dashed line of small dots along the fuselage
discrepancies.reference: A continuous, solid horizontal row of individual rectangular panes

discrepancies.observed: No visible door frames or structural breaks in the fuselage skin
discrepancies.reference: Distinct vertical and curved lines indicating passenger and cargo doors
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: add thin rectangular planes at specific intervals

discrepancies.observed: Uniformly spaced dots across the entire length
discrepancies.reference: Varied spacing with larger gaps around door locations
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase gap size near door positions
